# Documentation Instructions

Documentation serves both Copilot and the engineering team.

Create technical Markdown for:
- every reusable component
- every complex page container
- every shared helper with non-trivial business behavior

Each technical Markdown should explain:
- purpose
- business context
- inputs and outputs
- dependencies
- variants and states
- accessibility notes
- translation notes
- theming notes
- test expectations
- reuse guidance
- known extension points

Also create user-help documentation when a screen contains business rules or operational explanations that players or operators may need.
